summary: Welcome back. Today we study gradient descent, the workforce optimization algorithm behind most of machine learning.

key_points.text: Today we study gradient descent, the workforce optimization algorithm behind most of machine learning.
We will see what it does, why it works, and how to choose its settings.

title: The Update Rule — W <- W eta grad L(w) | eta = learning rate
summary: Choosing the learning rate matters a lot. If it is too large, the iterates oscillate or even diverge.

key_points.text: Choosing the learning rate matters a lot.
If it is too large, the iterates oscillate or even diverge.
If it is too small, training converges very slowly.

title: Choosing the Learning Rate — Too large: divergence oscillati
summary: Stochastic gradient descent estimates it from a small mini batch of examples. The estimate is noisy, but each step is much cheaper, so overall training is faster.

key_points.text: Stochastic gradient descent estimates it from a small mini batch of examples.
The estimate is noisy, but each step is much cheaper, so overall training is faster.
To summarize, gradient descent repeatedly steps along the negative gradient, the learning rate controls the step size, and stochastic gradient descent makes each step cheap by using mini batches.
